source: User-updated skill chart and Skills List

items.name: Parkour
items.description: A check made to climb or perform athletic or acrobatic feats.

items.name: Swim
items.description: A check made to swim through water or similar liquid. Wearing armor makes this more difficult.

items.name: Ride
items.description: A check made to stay on, steer and control your mount.

items.name: Sleight of Hand
items.description: A check made to do tricks, pickpocket and conceal things on your person.

items.name: Stealth
items.description: A check made to hide, move quietly or avoid detection.

items.name: Detect
items.description: A check made to perceive surroundings, follow tracks and find traps.

items.name: Heal
items.description: A check made to identify illness, stop bleeding and apply medicine.

items.name: Handle Device
items.description: A check made to pick locks or disable or manipulate traps, rope and other devices.

items.name: Navigate
items.description: A check made to determine direction, read maps and distinguish landmarks.

items.name: Research
items.description: A check made to obtain information from texts and experimentation.

items.name: Persuade
items.description: A check made to appeal to a target through charm, flirting or reasoning.

items.name: Deceive
items.description: A check made to deceive a target through false information, disguises or imitation.

items.name: Intimidate
items.description: A check made to scare a target through physical force or charisma.

items.name: Handle Animal
items.description: A check made to understand, calm and command animals.

items.name: Arcana
items.description: A check made to understand and identify magics, their purpose and their origin.

items.name: Divine
items.description: A check made to identify deities, their markings, teachings, followers and what entities follow them.

items.name: Nature
items.description: A check made to understand nature, plants, weather and non-beast aspects of nature.

items.name: Fabled
items.description: A check made to identify mythical or legendary creatures, including exceptionally rare beings such as phoenixes, pegasi, dragons and dracolythes, as well as their abilities, weaknesses, habits and origins.

items.name: Archaic
items.description: A check made to identify creatures that possess supernatural or magical abilities, their weaknesses, habits and locations.

items.name: Terrestrial
items.description: A check made to identify mundane animals, the tracks they leave behind and ascertain what their habits may be.

items.name: History
items.description: A check made to ascertain historical knowledge and how it pertains to a place or person.

items.name: Local
items.description: A check made to ascertain directions in towns and knowledge of unspoken rules, gangs and local conventions.

items.name: Blacksmithing
items.description: A check made to craft metal works.

items.name: Leather Working
items.description: A check made to craft leather works.

items.name: Engineering
items.description: A check made to craft contraptions or multifaceted mechanical objects.

items.name: Masonry
items.description: A check made to craft stone works.

items.name: Carpentry
items.description: A check made to craft wood works.

items.name: Finery
items.description: A check made to craft jewelry works.

items.name: Textiles
items.description: A check made to craft cloth works.

items.name: Paint
items.description: A check made to craft paint works.

items.name: Sculpting
items.description: A check made to craft sculpted works.

items.name: Mini Engineering
items.description: A check made to craft small mechanical contraptions.

items.name: Engrave/Brand
items.description: A check made to engrave or brand.

items.name: Act
items.description: A check made to perform.

items.name: Dance
items.description: A check made to dance.

items.name: Write
items.description: A check made to write.

items.name: Draw
items.description: A check made to draw.

items.name: Sing
items.description: A check made to sing.

items.name: Instrument
items.description: A check made to play an instrument.

items.name: Assist
items.description: Added to another character’s check as assistance; the GM determines appropriate situations and the number of assistants.
